relevance.rationale: Enumerative combinatorics of Gog and Magog trapezoids -- generalisations of alternating sign matrices and totally symmetric self-complementary plane partitions -- via constant-term formulas, an operator formula for monotone triangles, and Lindstrom--Gessel--Viennot lattice paths. A corpus grep over content/, computations/, docs/audits/ and docs/coordination/ returns ZERO occurrences of alternating sign matrices, plane partitions, monotone triangles, Gog/Magog, or TSSCPP. The document's two apparent bridges do not survive inspection: the two 'six-vertex' mentions are references to an alternative approach used by other authors and to the author's own earlier paper avoiding the six-vertex model, and the two 'Hecke' hits are substring false positives ('checked', 'coefficient') -- there is no Hecke algebra, no Schur function, and no Yang--Baxter equation in the text. The partitions in this document index ASM enumerations; the partitions in this corpus index Wedderburn blocks of H_n(q) and their Frobenius characters. Those are different uses of the same word. Scope note (a): this document, as read, supplies nothing usable here. It is not a claim that ASM/six-vertex methods are excluded from the framework -- the six-vertex model does connect to Temperley--Lieb and Hecke quotients in other work; this particular document simply does not carry that connection.
